_comment: Horusec reads ./horusec-config.json from the working directory (CI runs it from the repo root).
horusecCliFilesOrPathsToIgnore: the first two entries are Horusec's own defaults (setting this key replaces them).
The rest are INDIVIDUAL test files whose purpose is to exercise credential handling, so they hold fake
fixture keys/passwords by design (HS-LEAKS-25/26 false positives). They stay covered by the real secret
gates (gitleaks, TruffleHog, GitLab secret_detection). Do not widen this to whole directories.
horusecCliFalsePositiveHashes: per-finding FPs in non-test files (see _falsePositiveNotes). Horusec's hash
includes the line number, so if a listed line moves the finding re-appears: re-triage it and replace
the hash with the new vulnHash from `horusec start -o json`.
